form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: AMENDED report. Handwritten on the printed v. 12.23 form. The governing cover is page 2: 'Is this report an amendment?' = Yes, Date of Original Report 'Oct. 23 2024'; Office written 'Assessor'; signature Date 'Oct. 23, 2024'; Date of Report 'Oct. 25 2024'; clerk RECEIVED stamp OCT 25 2024, BY: Brian Voeks. On that amendment cover NO report-type box is marked - report_type_printed is '' rather than carried over from the original cover. BALANCE AT CLOSE IS NOT READABLE: the box holds a single curved stroke that resembles a cursive 2 or a partial glyph, clearly different from the filer's round zero in Box A; it is left '' and flagged - NOT derived from F minus D. Box B's thousands separator is written as a near-vertical tick rather than the clear commas used in C/D/E/F ('10|391.30'); all eight characters are present so the value is recorded as 10,391.30 at medium confidence. Box A is the filer's round-loop zero (medium). Schedule A (pages 3-4) itemizes contributions and totals 'Total Contributions Received $ 10,391.30'; Schedule B (pages 5-6) itemizes expenditures and totals 'Total Expenditures Made $ 10,391.30' - both agree with the summary boxes. Address, phone and signature are redacted upstream by the county (black bars), so residence_city is ''.

notes: TWO COVER PAGES, ONE REPORT. Page 1 is the ORIGINAL cover (amendment = No, report type 'Seven days preceding the General Election' marked, Office written 'County Assessor', signature date 'Oct. 23, 2024', Date of Report 'Oct. 24, 2024', clerk RECEIVED stamp OCT 23 2024) - it is bundled into the amendment packet as an attachment. Page 2 is the AMENDMENT cover and governs the filing (see the report note). There is only ONE summary page (p7, which the filer hand-numbered 'Page 6'); pages 3-6 are Schedules A and B. Pages 3-6 were not in the pre-rendered image set and were rendered here (pdftoppm) to confirm no second summary page exists. Not a two-report bundle - one report, emitted once.

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (10,391.30) on the p7 Summary Page — equal to the printed 'Total Contributions Received / Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report' (10,391.30) that BOTH Schedule A sheets carry, and equal to the sum of the two sheets' own printed 'Subtotal for this page' figures (2,562.88 + 7,828.42)
contributions.detail: SCHEDULE A RUNS ACROSS TWO SHEETS, each printing its own subtotal, so the gate was taken at both levels (L2 screen). PDF p3 (the filer's page 2): its 15 rows sum to 100.00 + 50.00 + 200.00 + 203.88 + 100.00 + 100.00 + 25.00 + 20.00 + 100.00 + 250.00 + 99.00 + 25.00 + 200.00 + 90 + 1000 = 2,562.88, exactly its printed subtotal (crop-proved to render '2,562.88'). PDF p4 (page 3): its 11 rows sum to 500.00 + 700.00 + 200.00 + 50.00 + 136.00 + 30.00 + 136.00 + 3000 + 2956.06 + 80.36 + 40.00 = 7,828.42, exactly its printed subtotal (crop-proved to render '7,828.42' — a first full-page reading of that cell as '1,828.42' was WRONG and the rows' own sum corrected it; the arithmetic outranked the glyph). The two subtotals sum to 2,562.88 + 7,828.42 = 10,391.30 = the grand total printed on both sheets = the promoted per-period Box B. Box C (Year to Date) prints the same 10,391.30 and is NOT summed as an increment. 26 rows in all.
